title: Detecting Flaky Tests and Finding Their Root Causes with Strands Agents and Gemini
why_read: A practical write-up on a real pain point, flaky tests, with a tool combining AI analysis for root-causing them.
analysis: Flaky tests, ones that pass or fail inconsistently without code changes, are a genuine and costly problem in CI pipelines because they erode trust in test suites and waste engineering time. This article describes a tool the author built that scores and analyzes test results, using an AI agent (Strands Agents with Gemini) to help do a first-pass root cause analysis. The core problem and motivation are solid and relatable, though the piece reads as a personal project showcase rather than a rigorous study of flaky test detection techniques. Useful for QA-focused engineers looking for a lightweight tool or inspiration for building one.
